bio.text: Nachman Caller was the Republican nominee in the May 2025 special election for New York's 22nd State Senate District in Brooklyn, running on the Conservative line as well.
City & State described him as an Orthodox lawyer who serves as a Republican district leader and has previously run for the Assembly.
BK Reader described him as a real estate attorney and community advocate for Borough Park.

sources.title: District 22 State Senate Election Underway for Brooklyn Voters
GOP looks to flip south Brooklyn Senate seat
